releaseNotes: Moved navigation from the 5-tab bottom bar to a left Navigation Drawer (Home, Records, Accounts, Budgets & Planned, Investments, Analytics & Insights, Smart Paste & Import, Settings) with a single floating + button.
Decluttered Home with Overview and Budgets tabs: Overview contains only the horizontal Accounts Strip, unified Total Balance & Current Cash Flow card, and Last 3 Recent Records.

Added tap-to-open Account Detail sheets (30-day balance trendline, account transactions, edit, repay, and delete), emerald-themed Payment Capture, Title Case user names, and clean Budgets & Investments empty states.
